decisions.reason: Uses LinkType Junction/Target and the link: marker to show the profile entry resolves to the repo; repo edits already deploy; copying is a self-copy; contrasts with a copied install.

Attributes EBUSY and stale module state to the running host; closing the tab releases nothing; separately explains browser HTTP cache and requires host restart plus hard refresh, without treating caches as file locks.
Explains the rename traversed the junction onto the sole source files, making the follow-up copy fail; restores .old2 files by rename, verifies with node --check, stops the host first.
Gives the correct dependency order: full host stop, start, cache-bypass refresh, then functional/served-bytes verification; notes syntax check alone is not activation.
Preflight inspects LinkType/Target and the cordis.patch.yml link: marker before any file operation, branches linked vs copied, and explains why generic copy advice caused the incident.

caps.reason: Final plan contains no copy; renames .old2 back in place and treats both paths as one physical tree.
Plan mandates full host stop/start; explicitly states browser actions release nothing.
